speaker: Rufus
original_jp: お前が… オーディン！？

speaker: Odin
original_en:
A lowly vessel trying to attain the power
of the gods? Such arrogance.
original_jp: 器の分際で神の力を得ようとは…なんという〓〓な

speaker: Odin
original_en:
Imbecile! It's time you learned just what
a god is!
original_jp: 貴様…神の何たるかを教えてやる

speaker: Odin
original_en: None shall lay hands upon it!
original_jp: 何人たりとも それに〓れる事は許さん

speaker: Rufus
original_en:
Now that I find a little hard to believe.
Who'd think arrogance would ever offend
you?
original_jp: こりゃ驚いたぜ…お前の口から〓〓なんて言葉が出るとはな

speaker: Lezard
original_en:
Foolish god, blinded by the Dragon Orb's
shine! Your grip upon Gungnir fades.
original_jp: ドラゴンオーブの輝きに目を奪われグングニルを御する力をも鈍らせた愚神 <PART> ――

speaker: Lezard
original_en: The hand worthy of wielding this divine lance...
original_jp: この神槍を手にするに相応しきは <PART> ――

speaker: Lezard
original_en: That which does not grow falls into decay.
original_jp: 成長を〓れば 〓退に転じるは世の習い

speaker: Rufus
original_en: Hey, I'm only a soul now.

speaker: Rufus
original_en: I need you to materialize me quick!
original_jp: 早いとこマテリアライズしてくれよ！

speaker: Rufus
original_en:
Just now, for a moment, I felt it.
It kinda felt...
original_jp: 今 一瞬 感じたぜ…なんていうか とっても…

speaker: Rufus
original_en: Did you, by any chance...lose it?
original_jp: …ひょっとして 失くしちまった？

speaker: Rufus
original_en:
Well look for it! It must be somewhere
around here.
original_jp: 探そう！ この辺りにあるはずだろ…

speaker: Rufus
original_en:
Fell off? Why didn't you say so earlier?
Let's go find it!
original_jp: なんだ わかってるなら話が早いぜすぐ探しに行こう！

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: …ルーファス！？ どこにいるの！？

speaker: Rufus
original_en:
Still alive...and right in front of
your very eyes!
original_jp: 目の前にいるぜ！俺はまだ死んじゃいない

speaker: Rufus
original_en:
Man, I never suspected Lezard had a
trick in store for me this far along!
original_jp: まさか この期に及んでレザードに〓められるとはなぁ…

speaker: Rufus
original_en:
Telling me I was mankind's only hope
when he was really after Odin's spirit...
original_jp: 俺にすがるとか言いやがって〓いはオーディンの精神だったってわけだ…

speaker: Alicia
original_en: He was lying to us the whole time.
original_jp: ずっと騙されていたなんて…

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: こうしちゃいられないぜ…

speaker: Rufus
original_en:
If we don't retrieve at least the Dragon
Orb right away, it'll be too late!
original_jp: 早いとこドラゴンオーブだけでも取り返さなきゃ手遅れになる！

speaker: Rufus
original_en:
What do you mean? What do you think I
came all this way for?
original_jp: 当たり前だろ！何しにここまで来たんだ！？

speaker: Rufus
original_en:
To save Midgard, of course! We'll just
have to let Lezard be for now.
original_jp: ミッドガルドを救うためだろ！この際レザードは放っとくしかない

speaker: Rufus
original_en:
Let's just hope he hasn't conquered
Valhalla before we get there!
original_jp: あいつが先にヴァルハラを乗っ取りに行ってない事を祈ろうぜ！

speaker: Rufus
original_en:
Plus, if we can save Brahms and team up,
we just might have a chance!
original_jp: ついでにブラムスも助けて味方につけりゃまだまだ勝ち目はあるって！

speaker: Rufus
original_en:
Oh, come on. It won't kill you, you know.
You may be human in spirit, but your body
is undead.
original_jp: そんな物 使っても死ねないぜ魂は人間でも体は不死者なんだから

speaker: Rufus
original_en:
The horrible pain I was feeling disappeared
all of a sudden, like magic.
original_jp: さっきまでの死にそうな痛みは嘘みたいに消えちまったよ

speaker: Rufus
original_en:
You know, the body really does imprison
the soul.
original_jp: 肉体が魂の足〓だってのは本当だな

speaker: Rufus
original_en:
But, if I stay like this, I'm going to
disappear sooner or later.
original_jp: とは言っても このままじゃ遅かれ早かれ消えちまう…

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: シルメリア 力を〓して…

speaker: Rufus
original_en:
I'm here, inside.
Now, concentrate your mind on the ring.
original_jp: 中にいるよさあ次は指輪に精神を集中させて…

speaker: Rufus
original_en: Hey, hey, don't count me out just yet...
original_jp: おいおい 俺ぁ最後かよ…

speaker: Rufus
original_en:
After you promised we'd go to Valhalla
together, you're backing out on me?
original_jp: 一緒にヴァルハラへ行くって約束したのに あんまりじゃねえか…

speaker: Rufus
original_en: Try it again and it'll work.

speaker: Alicia
original_en:
No one will be able to attain the power
of the gods here now.
original_jp: もう ここで神の力を得る事はできないのね…

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: ルーファス！ ルーファス！

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: しっかりして！ 目を覚まして！

speaker: Odin
original_en:
Blaspheming, undead imposter...
To oblivion with the both of you!
original_jp: えせ不死者が 〓顔極まりない… ならばともに成敗してくれよう

speaker: Alicia
original_en: I can't run away... Not without you!
original_jp: 私一人… 逃げられない…

speaker: Odin
original_en:
Using astral projection to sneak up here?
You've crossed the line, all of you!
original_jp: 〓体に離脱し ここまで〓び込むとは…貴様も超えてはならぬ一〓を超えたな

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: やっと追いつきました…

speaker: Lezard
original_en:
After my teleportation spell failed, I
became separated from the group.
original_jp: 〓送方陣に失敗し皆様をお救いできず長らく独り はぐれておりました…

speaker: Lezard
original_en:
Though I doubt I'll be much of a match
for him.
original_jp: …しかし私ごときが対抗できるかどうか…

speaker: Odin
original_en:
It is a shame to waste such a vessel, but
no one commits sacrilege against me!
original_jp: 器を失うのは〓しいが 我に対する罪深き無礼な行いは不問に付せぬ <PART> ――

speaker: Odin
original_en:
The human host of Silmeria... You think
that entitles you to be here?
original_jp: シルメリアの宿主だった人間か…神の端くれにでもなったつもりか？
